usage_details.scope: Selected discovery invocation plus each latest evaluated probe; excludes superseded failed attempts. Not the total spend of all retries.
usage_details.token_semantics: input includes cached input; total=input+output; reason is a subset of output. null means unrecorded. Incomplete usage is a recorded lower bound.
usage_details.cost_note: Unknown costs remain null; no pricing estimates or zero-cost assumptions.

update.update_message: Imported latest selected logs per results/README.md. Original performance fields and scores preserved; added provenance, submission and recorded usage. No model calls or rescoring.

run_metadata.timing_note: Original performance timing semantics retained. Probe-only/evaluation-only total_seconds covers that retry, not all historical attempts.
